Follow me on the socials for current updates, what I'm planning, or just general shenanigans! [url=https://www.tumblr.com/blog/maggplays]Tumblr[/url] | [url=https://bsky.app/profile/maggplays.bsky.social]Bluesky[/url]

[size=3]PERMISSIONS[/size]
Do NOT copy and re-post this mod elsewhere without requesting permission. I worked heckin’ hard on this mod, it’s my baby and I would hate to see it uploaded by someone who didn’t do the work.
[b]Modders:[/b] You may use this file as an example of 1.6 code formatting as a reference only, do not copy my dialogue. If you have questions, feel free to message me.
[b]Streamers:[/b] Feel free to stream this mod, just add a link back here for download and credit.
